rationale_overall: The watchlist rotates one slot from single-name nuclear-power AI exposure (CEG, dinged by DeepSeek) into direct European rearmament/defense-tech exposure (SHLD), keeping the AI trio (MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA) intact on continued momentum (MSFT's $80B FY25 capex plan, GOOGL's Mar 18 Wiz agreement, NVDA's GTC Blackwell-in-production). This reflects the profile's mandate to trim before crest on a wave that just took a valuation gut-check, and to enter on buildup in defense now that EU/Germany commitments went from rhetoric to priced policy. Quantum/robotics/rockets produced no dated catalyst strong enough to displace a name at this 4-ticker cap. Result: MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA, SHLD.
